ko.B: "일곱 광주리입니다" 하고 그들이 대답하였다.
ko.R: 제자들이 대답했다. "일곱 광주리였습니다."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dicen: «Siete».
es.B: «Siete», contestaron.
es.R: Ellos contestaron: «Siete».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent : « Sept. »
fr.B: « Sept », répondirent-ils.
fr.R: Ils ont répondu : « Sept. »

sw.L: Nao wanamwambia, "Saba."
sw.B: "Saba," wakasema.
sw.R: Wakajibu, "Saba."

decisions.choice: they say: present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: As in 8:19, the sense is past.

source.text: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Οὔπω συνίετε;

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, Not yet do you understand?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Do you not yet understand?"
en.B: He said to them, "And you still do not understand?"
en.R: Then Jesus said to them, "And you still do not understand?"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các con vẫn chưa hiểu sao?"
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Thế mà các con vẫn chưa hiểu sao?"
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Thế mà các con vẫn chưa hiểu sao?"

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "아직도 깨닫지 못하느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그런데도 아직 깨닫지 못하느냐?"
ko.R: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그런데도 아직 깨닫지 못하느냐?"

es.L: Y les decía: «¿Todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}?».
es.B: Entonces les dijo: «¿Y todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}?».
es.R: Entonces Jesús les dijo: «¿Y todavía no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}}?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « Vous ne comprenez pas encore ? »
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Et vous ne comprenez toujours pas ? »
fr.R: Alors Jésus leur a dit : « Et vous ne comprenez toujours pas ? »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Bado hamwelewi?"
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Na bado hamwelewi?"
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Na bado hamwelewi?"

decisions.choice: not yet understand: the disciples have seen but not grasped who Jesus is
alternatives: they do not understand the arithmetic
decisions.reason: The question is left open. The next scenes, the blind man healed in two stages (8:22-26) and Peter's confession (8:29), show their sight beginning to come.

decisions.choice: was saying: an imperfect, he said
decisions.reason: Mark often uses this form for Jesus' sayings. It does not change the sense.

source.text: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Βηθσαϊδάν.

records.literal_gloss: And they come to Bethsaida.

en.L: And they come to Bethsaida.
en.B: They came to Bethsaida.
en.R: Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers came to the town of Bethsaida.

vi.L: Và họ đến Bết-sai-đa.
vi.B: Họ đến Bết-sai-đa.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ đến thị trấn Bết-sai-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 벳새다로 온다.
ko.B: 그들은 벳새다에 이르렀다.
ko.R: 예수와 제자들은 벳새다라는 마을에 갔다.

es.L: Y llegan a Betsaida.
es.B: Llegaron a Betsaida.
es.R: Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos llegaron al pueblo de Betsaida.

fr.L: Et ils viennent à Bethsaïda.
fr.B: Ils arrivèrent à Bethsaïda.
fr.R: Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples sont arrivés dans la ville de Bethsaïda.

sw.L: Na wanakuja Bethsaida.
sw.B: Wakafika Bethsaida.
sw.R: Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakafika katika mji wa Bethsaida.

decisions.choice: Bethsaida: a fishing town at the north end of the lake
decisions.reason: Bethsaida lay just east of where the Jordan enters the lake. Philip the tetrarch had rebuilt it as a city, but Mark calls it a village (8:23). It was the town Jesus sent the disciples toward in 6:45.

decisions.choice: Jesus and his followers; the town of
decisions.reason: Readable names who came and says that Bethsaida is a town.

source.text: καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ τυφλὸν καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα αὐτοῦ ἅψηται.

records.literal_gloss: And they bring to him a blind [man] and implore him that him he might touch.

en.L: And they bring to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a blind [man] and beg {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to touch him.
en.B: Some people brought a blind man to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and pleaded with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to touch him.
en.R: Some people brought a blind man to Jesus. They begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to touch the man.

vi.L: Và người ta đem một [người] mù đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào anh ta.
vi.B: Có mấy người dẫn một người mù đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào anh.
vi.R: Có mấy người dẫn một người mù đến với Đức Giê-xu. Họ nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào người ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 그분께 눈먼 사람을 데리고 와서, 그를 만져 주시기를 그분께 간청한다.
ko.B: 사람들이 눈먼 사람 하나를 예수께 데리고 와서, 그에게 손을 대 주시기를 간청하였다.
ko.R: 사람들이 눈먼 사람 하나를 예수께 데리고 왔다. 그리고 그 사람을 만져 주시라고 예수께 간절히 부탁했다.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traen un ciego y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ruegan que lo toque.
es.B: Unas personas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevaron un ciego y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suplicaron que lo tocara.
es.R: Unas personas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevaron un ciego a Jesús. Le rogaron que tocara al hombre.

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amènent un aveugle, et ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplient de le toucher.
fr.B: On {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amena un aveugle, et on {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplia de le toucher.
fr.R: Des gens ont amené un aveugle à Jésus. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont supplié de toucher cet homme.

sw.L: Na wanamletea kipofu, nao wanamsihi amguse.
sw.B: Watu fulani wakamletea kipofu mmoja, wakamsihi amguse.
sw.R: Watu fulani walimletea Yesu mtu kipofu. Wakamsihi amguse mtu huyo.

decisions.choice: they bring: people of the town, not the disciples
decisions.reason: The subject is general, as in 7:32.

decisions.choice: touch him: people believed Jesus healed by touch
decisions.reason: Jesus had healed by touch many times (1:41; 5:41; 6:5; 7:33).

decisions.choice: some people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that others, not the disciples, brought the man.

decisions.choice: lo toque
decisions.reason: Here "lo" is the blind man, not Jesus, so it takes no setting.

source.text: καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ τυφλοῦ ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς κώμης, καὶ πτύσας εἰς τὰ ὄμματα αὐτοῦ, ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ, ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν· Εἴ τι βλέπεις;

records.literal_gloss: And having taken hold of the hand of the blind [man] he led out him outside the village, and having spit on the eyes of him, having laid the hands on him, he was asking him, If anything you see?

en.L: And taking hold of the blind [man's] hand, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led him out of the village, and when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spit on his eyes [and] laid [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] hands on him, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked him, "Do you see anything?"
en.B: He took hold of the blind man's hand and took him outside the village. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spat on the man's eyes, laid {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on him, and asked, "Can you see anything?"
en.R: Jesus took the blind man's hand and walked with him out of the village. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spit on the man's eyes and put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on him. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked, "Can you see anything?"

vi.L: Và nắm lấy tay người mù, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn anh ta ra ngoài làng, và nhổ nước bọt vào mắt anh ta, đặt tay trên anh ta, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi anh ta: "Anh có thấy gì không?"
vi.B: Ngài nắm tay người mù, dẫn anh ra ngoài làng. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhổ nước bọt vào mắt anh, đặt tay trên anh và hỏi: "Anh có thấy gì không?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nắm tay người mù và dẫn anh ra khỏi làng. Ở đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhổ nước bọt vào mắt anh và đặt tay trên anh. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi: "Anh có thấy gì không?"

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그 눈먼 사람의 손을 잡고 그를 마을 밖으로 데리고 나가셨다. 그리고 그의 눈에 침을 뱉으시고 그에게 손을 얹으신 뒤에 그에게 물으셨다. "무엇이 보이느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 눈먼 사람의 손을 잡고 마을 밖으로 데리고 나가셨다. 그리고 그의 눈에 침을 뱉으시고, 그에게 손을 얹으신 다음에 물으셨다. "무엇이 좀 보이느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 그 눈먼 사람의 손을 잡고 함께 마을 밖으로 나가셨다. 거기서 그 사람의 눈에 침을 뱉으시고 그 사람에게 손을 얹으셨다. 그리고 물으셨다. "무엇이 보이느냐?"

es.L: Y tomando de la mano al ciego, lo sacó fuera de la aldea, y habiéndole escupido en los ojos [y] puesto las manos sobre él, le preguntaba: «¿Ves algo?».
es.B: Tomó de la mano al ciego y lo llevó fuera de la aldea. Le escupió en los ojos, le puso las manos encima y le preguntó: «¿Puedes ver algo?».
es.R: Jesús tomó de la mano al ciego y salió con él de la aldea. Allí le escupió en los ojos y le puso {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos encima. Luego le preguntó: «¿Puedes ver algo?».

fr.L: Et, ayant pris la main de l’aveugle, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le conduisit hors du village et, ayant craché sur ses yeux [et] lui ayant imposé les mains, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui demandait : « Vois-tu quelque chose ? »
fr.B: Il prit l’aveugle par la main et le conduisit hors du village. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} cracha sur les yeux de l’homme, posa les mains sur lui et lui demanda : « Vois-tu quelque chose ? »
fr.R: Jésus a pris l’aveugle par la main et l’a emmené hors du village. Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a craché sur les yeux de l’homme et a posé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains sur lui. Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui a demandé : « Est-ce que tu vois quelque chose ? »

sw.L: Naye akimshika mkono yule kipofu, akampeleka nje ya kijiji; na akiisha kutema mate machoni pake [na] kuweka mikono [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] juu yake, akamwuliza, "Je, unaona kitu?"
sw.B: Akamshika kipofu mkono, akampeleka nje ya kijiji. Kisha akatema mate machoni pake, akaweka mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yake, akamwuliza, "Unaweza kuona kitu chochote?"
sw.R: Yesu akamshika mkono yule kipofu, akatembea naye mpaka nje ya kijiji. Huko akatema mate machoni pa mtu huyo, akaweka mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu yake. Kisha akamwuliza, "Unaweza kuona kitu chochote?"

decisions.choice: spit on his eyes: saliva was thought to have healing power
decisions.reason: People in that world used saliva as a remedy. Jesus used it with the deaf man too (7:33). Here it is a touch of care.

decisions.choice: outside the village: Jesus heals him away from the crowd
decisions.reason: As with the deaf man (7:33), the healing takes place in private.

decisions.choice: if you see anything: a direct question
alternatives: an indirect question, he asked him whether he saw anything
decisions.reason: In questions of this time the word for if can introduce a direct question. The SBLGNT prints the words as Jesus' own.

decisions.choice: can you see
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable ask about the man's ability to see, which is the point of the question.

decisions.choice: Jesus calls the man "anh", and the man says "tôi"
decisions.reason: The usual address to a grown man of about one's own age; the scene gives no sign that he is old or a child.

source.text: καὶ ἀναβλέψας ἔλεγεν· Βλέπω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ὅτι ὡς δένδρα ὁρῶ περιπατοῦντας.

records.literal_gloss: And having looked up he was saying, I see the men, for as trees I see walking.

en.L: And looking up, he said, "I see {{gender:people|men}}, for I see [them] like trees, walking."
en.B: The man looked up and said, "I see {{gender:people|men}}, but to me they are like trees moving about."
en.R: The man looked up and said, "I see {{gender:people|men}}! They look like trees that are walking."

vi.L: Và ngước lên, anh ta nói: "Tôi thấy người ta, vì tôi thấy [họ] như cây cối đang đi."
vi.B: Anh ngước lên và nói: "Tôi thấy người ta, nhưng họ trông như cây cối đang đi lại."
vi.R: Anh ngước lên và nói: "Tôi thấy người ta! Họ trông giống như những cái cây đang đi."

ko.L: 그러자 그가 쳐다보며 말하였다. "사람들이 보입니다. 나무 같은 것들이 걸어 다니는 것이 보이기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 그 사람이 쳐다보며 말하였다. "사람들이 보이기는 하는데, 나무 같은 것들이 걸어 다니는 것처럼 보입니다."
ko.R: 그 사람이 눈을 들어 보고 말했다. "사람들이 보입니다! 그런데 꼭 나무들이 걸어 다니는 것 같습니다."

es.L: Y alzando la vista, decía: «Veo {{gender:personas|hombres}}, porque [{{gender:las|los}}] veo como árboles que caminan».
es.B: El hombre levantó la vista y dijo: «Veo {{gender:personas|hombres}}, pero me parecen árboles que caminan».
es.R: El hombre miró y dijo: «¡Veo {{gender:personas|hombres}}! Parecen árboles que caminan».

fr.L: Et, ayant levé les yeux, il disait : « Je vois {{gender:les gens|les hommes}}, car je [les] vois comme des arbres, qui marchent. »
fr.B: L’homme leva les yeux et dit : « Je vois {{gender:des gens|des hommes}}, mais ils me paraissent comme des arbres qui marchent. »
fr.R: L’homme a levé les yeux et a dit : « Je vois {{gender:des gens|des hommes}} ! On dirait des arbres qui marchent. »

sw.L: Naye akatazama juu, akawa akisema, "Ninaona watu, kwa maana ninawaona kama miti, wakitembea."
sw.B: Mtu huyo akatazama juu, akasema, "Ninaona watu, lakini kwangu wanaonekana kama miti inayotembea."
sw.R: Mtu huyo akatazama juu, akasema, "Ninaona watu! Wanaonekana kama miti inayotembea."

decisions.choice: looked up: lifted his eyes, or began to see again
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to look up or to recover sight. Here he looks up and sees only in part.

decisions.choice: I see people, for I see them like trees: he knows they are people only because they move
decisions.reason: The shapes look like trees to him. He can tell they are people because they walk.

decisions.choice: people: human beings in general
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for human beings.

decisions.choice: but
decisions.reason: The small word here explains how he knows they are people. In English it reads more clearly as a contrast.

decisions.choice: "người ta", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Người ta" (people) already takes in men and women, so the English gender setting has nothing to choose between in Vietnamese. The same holds for "người ta" in 8:27, "loài người" in 8:33 and "người ấy", "mình" in 8:34-38.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span, here and through chapter 8 (8:27, 8:33, 8:36-37)
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already includes men and women, and Korean needs no pronoun where English says "his" or "their" (자기), so the English gender spans have no Korean counterpart (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: The man speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 ("보입니다")
decisions.reason: People speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (style guide, section 4).

decisions.choice: {{gender:personas|hombres}}
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:17: the word means human beings (meaning decision m3). In Literal the pronoun after it must agree, so it takes the same setting.

decisions.choice: watu (people), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Swahili "watu" already means people, men and women; the only male word, "wanaume", would change the meaning, so the gender setting has nothing to change in this chapter (also 8:27, 8:33-38).

source.text: εἶτα πάλιν ἐπέθηκεν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ διέβλεψεν καὶ ἀπεκατέστη καὶ ἐνέβλεπεν τηλαυγῶς ἅπαντα.

records.literal_gloss: Then again he laid the hands on the eyes of him, and he saw clearly and he was restored, and he was seeing clearly all things.

en.L: Then again {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] hands on his eyes, and he looked intently and was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
en.B: Then Jesus laid {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on the man's eyes once more. The man looked hard, his sight came back, and he could see everything clearly.
en.R: Then Jesus put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands on the man's eyes again. The man looked carefully, and his eyes were healed. Now he could see everything clearly.

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại đặt tay trên mắt anh ta, và anh ta nhìn chăm chú, và được phục hồi, và thấy rõ mọi vật.
vi.B: Rồi Đức Giê-xu đặt tay trên mắt anh một lần nữa. Anh nhìn chăm chú, thị lực được phục hồi, và anh thấy rõ mọi vật.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu lại đặt tay trên mắt anh. Anh nhìn kỹ, và mắt anh được chữa lành. Bây giờ anh thấy rõ mọi vật.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 다시 그의 눈에 손을 얹으셨다. 그러자 그가 뚫어지게 보더니 회복되어, 모든 것을 밝히 보게 되었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 다시 그의 눈에 손을 얹으셨다. 그 사람이 눈을 크게 뜨고 바라보더니, 시력이 회복되어 모든 것을 똑똑히 보게 되었다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그 사람의 눈에 다시 손을 얹으셨다. 그 사람이 자세히 바라보았다. 그러자 눈이 다 나아서, 이제는 모든 것을 똑똑히 볼 수 있었다.

es.L: Luego otra vez le puso las manos sobre los ojos, y él miró fijamente y quedó restablecido, y veía todo con claridad.
es.B: Entonces Jesús le puso otra vez {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sobre los ojos. El hombre miró con atención, recobró la vista y podía ver todo con claridad.
es.R: Entonces Jesús le puso otra vez {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sobre los ojos. El hombre miró con cuidado, y sus ojos quedaron sanos. Ahora podía ver todo claramente.

fr.L: Puis de nouveau {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} posa les mains sur ses yeux, et il regarda fixement, et il fut rétabli, et il voyait tout distinctement.
fr.B: Jésus posa de nouveau les mains sur les yeux de l’homme. Celui-ci regarda attentivement ; sa vue lui fut rendue, et il voyait tout clairement.
fr.R: Alors Jésus a posé encore une fois {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains sur les yeux de l’homme. L’homme a regardé avec attention, et ses yeux ont été guéris. Maintenant, il voyait tout clairement.

sw.L: Kisha akaweka tena mikono [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] juu ya macho yake, naye akakaza macho, akapona, akawa anaona vitu vyote waziwazi.
sw.B: Kisha Yesu akaweka mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu ya macho ya mtu huyo tena. Mtu huyo akakaza macho, kuona kwake kukarudi, naye akaweza kuona kila kitu waziwazi.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akaweka tena mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu ya macho ya mtu huyo. Mtu huyo akatazama kwa makini, na macho yake yakapona. Sasa aliweza kuona kila kitu waziwazi.

decisions.choice: a healing in two stages: a picture of the disciples, who see only in part
decisions.reason: This is the only healing in the Gospels done in two stages. It stands between the disciples' blindness (8:18) and Peter's confession, where Peter sees who Jesus is but not yet that he must suffer (8:29-33). Mark does not explain the link.

decisions.choice: looked intently: looked hard and saw through
decisions.reason: The verb means to see clearly or to stare. The man fixes his eyes and his sight comes back.

decisions.choice: restored: made as he had been
decisions.reason: The same verb as for the withered hand (3:5).

decisions.choice: he saw: he went on seeing
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense shows his sight lasted.

decisions.choice: Jesus (B, R); the man (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name each person, since the Greek uses he for both.

source.text: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον αὐτοῦ λέγων· Μηδὲ εἰς τὴν κώμην εἰσέλθῃς.

records.literal_gloss: And he sent him to [the] home of him, saying, Not even into the village may you enter.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent him to his home, saying, "Do not even enter the village."
en.B: Jesus sent him off home, telling him, "Do not even set foot in the village."
en.R: Jesus sent him home. He told him, "Do not even go back into the village."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai anh ta về nhà mình, nói: "Ngay cả làng, anh cũng đừng vào."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu cho anh về nhà và dặn: "Anh đừng vào làng, dù chỉ ghé qua."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu bảo anh về nhà. Ngài dặn: "Anh đừng quay trở vào làng."

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그를 그의 집으로 보내시며 말씀하셨다. "마을에는 들어가지도 마라."
ko.B: 예수께서 그를 집으로 보내시며 말씀하셨다. "마을에는 들어가지도 마라."
ko.R: 예수께서 그 사람을 집으로 보내시며 말씀하셨다. "마을로 다시 들어가지도 마라."

es.L: Y lo envió a su casa, diciendo: «Ni siquiera entres en la aldea».
es.B: Jesús lo mandó a su casa y le dijo: «Ni siquiera pongas un pie en la aldea».
es.R: Jesús lo mandó a su casa. Le dijo: «Ni siquiera vuelvas a entrar en la aldea».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le renvoya dans sa maison, en disant : « N’entre même pas dans le village. »
fr.B: Jésus le renvoya chez lui en lui disant : « Ne mets même pas les pieds dans le village. »
fr.R: Jésus l’a renvoyé chez lui. Il lui a dit : « Ne retourne même pas dans le village. »

sw.L: Naye akampeleka nyumbani kwake, akisema, "Usiingie hata kijijini."
sw.B: Yesu akamtuma aende nyumbani kwake, akimwambia, "Usikanyage hata kijijini."
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia aende nyumbani. Akamwambia, "Usirudi hata kijijini."

decisions.choice: do not even enter the village, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: do not enter the village nor tell anyone in the village
go to your home, and do not tell anyone in the village
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add or substitute "and do not tell anyone in the village", which makes plain the command to keep quiet found in 1:44, 5:43 and 7:36. The shorter reading is found in early manuscripts. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: not even: he is to go straight home
alternatives: he may never return to the village
decisions.reason: Jesus keeps the healing quiet, as in 7:36. The man is not to pass through the village on the way.

decisions.choice: go back into
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the man came from the village.

source.text: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς κώμας Καισαρείας τῆς Φιλίππου· καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐπηρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων αὐτοῖς· Τίνα με λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι;

records.literal_gloss: And went out Jesus and the disciples of him into the villages of Caesarea of Philip; and on the road he was asking the disciples of him saying to them, Whom me do say the men to be?

en.L: And Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples went out into the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, saying to them, "Who do {{gender:people|men}} say that I am?"
en.B: Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples set out for the villages of the Caesarea Philippi area. As they went, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "Who do {{gender:people|men}} say I am?"
en.R: Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers went to the villages near the city of Caesarea Philippi. As they walked, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "Who do people say I am?"

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu cùng các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi đến các làng thuộc Sê-sa-rê Phi-líp; và trên đường đi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói với họ: "Người ta nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ đi đến các làng trong vùng Sê-sa-rê Phi-líp. Dọc đường, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Người ta nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ đi đến những làng gần thành Sê-sa-rê Phi-líp. Trong khi đi đường, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Người ta nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"

ko.L: 그리고 예수께서 자기 제자들과 함께 빌립보 가이사랴의 마을들로 나가셨다. 그리고 길에서 자기 제자들에게 물으시며 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "사람들이 나를 누구라고 말하느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 제자들과 함께 빌립보 가이사랴 지방의 마을들로 길을 떠나셨다. 가시는 길에 예수께서 제자들에게 물으셨다. "사람들이 나를 누구라고 하느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들과 함께 빌립보 가이사랴라는 도시 근처의 마을들로 가셨다. 길을 가면서 예수께서 제자들에게 물으셨다. "사람들이 나를 누구라고 하느냐?"

es.L: Y salieron Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos hacia las aldeas de Cesarea de Filipo; y en el camino preguntaba a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, diciéndoles: «¿Quién {{gender:dice la gente|dicen los hombres}} que soy yo?».
es.B: Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos se fueron a las aldeas de la región de Cesarea de Filipo. Por el camino les preguntó: «¿Quién {{gender:dice la gente|dicen los hombres}} que soy yo?».
es.R: Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos fueron a las aldeas cercanas a la ciudad de Cesarea de Filipo. Mientras caminaban, les preguntó: «¿Quién dice la gente que soy yo?».

fr.L: Et Jésus sortit, ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, vers les villages de Césarée de Philippe ; et en chemin {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} interrogeait {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, leur disant : « Qui {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} disent-ils que je suis ? »
fr.B: Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples partirent vers les villages de la région de Césarée de Philippe. En chemin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur demanda : « Qui suis-je, d’après {{gender:les gens|les hommes}} ? »
fr.R: Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples sont allés dans les villages près de la ville de Césarée de Philippe. Pendant qu’ils marchaient, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a demandé : « D’après les gens, qui est-ce que je suis ? »

sw.L: Na Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakatoka kwenda vijiji vya Kaisaria ya Filipo; na njiani akawa akiwauliza wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akiwaambia, "Watu wanasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"
sw.B: Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikwenda kwenye vijiji vya eneo la Kaisaria ya Filipo. Walipokuwa njiani, aliwauliza, "Watu wanasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"
sw.R: Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikwenda katika vijiji vilivyokuwa karibu na mji wa Kaisaria ya Filipo. Walipokuwa wakitembea njiani, akawauliza, "Watu wanasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"

decisions.choice: Caesarea Philippi: a city at the foot of Mount Hermon, north of the lake
decisions.reason: Philip the tetrarch rebuilt the town and named it for Caesar. It was called Philip's to tell it apart from Caesarea by the sea. It lay in mostly Gentile country at the source of the Jordan.

decisions.choice: on the way: the road becomes the setting for Jesus' teaching
decisions.reason: From here to 10:52 Jesus teaches the disciples on the way to Jerusalem, and the word recurs (9:33; 10:32; 10:52).

decisions.choice: people: people in general
decisions.reason: The word is the general word for human beings.

decisions.choice: the villages of the area (B); the villages near the city of (R)
decisions.reason: The villages belonged to the area of the city. Readable adds that Caesarea Philippi was a city.

decisions.choice: "Sê-sa-rê Phi-líp"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliteration, as the style guide sets for names; the second form is the Catholic one.

decisions.choice: "빌립보 가이사랴", the Protestant form of Caesarea Philippi
decisions.reason: The settled Protestant forms of names (style guide, Settled), with "가이사" as in the guide's list.

decisions.choice: "예수께서 자기 제자들과 함께" for "Jesus and his disciples went out"
decisions.reason: With a joint subject Korean must choose whether the verb is honorific; making Jesus the subject "with" his disciples keeps the honorific "나가셨다" without honouring the disciples.

decisions.choice: {{gender:dice la gente|dicen los hombres}}
decisions.reason: The word means people in general (meaning decision m3). The verb must agree with the noun, so the setting takes in both.

decisions.choice: Kaisaria ya Filipo
decisions.reason: The city's name, "Caesarea of Philip", in its usual Swahili form, with "ya" for the Greek "of", so it stays apart from the other Caesarea on the coast (Acts).

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι Ἰωάννην τὸν βαπτιστήν, καὶ ἄλλοι Ἠλίαν, ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι εἷς τῶν προφητῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him saying that, John the Baptist, and others Elijah, others but that one of the prophets.

en.L: And they told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, one of the prophets."
en.B: They answered, "Some say John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets."
en.R: They answered, "Some people say {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are John the Baptist. Others say {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are Elijah. And others say {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are one of the prophets."

vi.L: Và họ thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Giăng Báp-tít; và những người khác, Ê-li; còn những người khác, một trong các nhà tiên tri."
vi.B: Họ thưa: "Có người nói là Giăng Báp-tít, có người nói là Ê-li, còn những người khác nói là một trong các nhà tiên tri."
vi.R: Họ trả lời: "Có người nói Thầy là Giăng Báp-tít. Người khác nói Thầy là Ê-li. Còn có người nói Thầy là một trong các nhà tiên tri."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 그분께 말하였다. "세례자 요한이라고 [합니다]. 또 다른 사람들은 엘리야라고 하고, 또 다른 사람들은 예언자들 가운데 하나라고 합니다."
ko.B: 그들이 대답하였다. "세례자 요한이라고 하는 사람들도 있고, 엘리야라고 하는 사람들도 있고, 예언자 가운데 한 분이라고 하는 사람들도 있습니다."
ko.R: 제자들이 대답했다. "어떤 사람들은 선생님을 세례자 요한이라고 합니다. 엘리야라고 하는 사람들도 있고, 예언자 가운데 한 분이라고 하는 사람들도 있습니다."

es.L: Y ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondieron, diciendo: «Juan el Bautista; y otros, Elías; y otros, uno de los profetas».
es.B: Ellos respondieron: «Unos dicen que Juan el Bautista; otros, que Elías; y otros, que uno de los profetas».
es.R: Ellos contestaron: «Algunos dicen que eres Juan el Bautista. Otros dicen que eres Elías. Y otros, que eres uno de los profetas».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} répondirent en disant : « Jean le Baptiste ; et d’autres, Élie ; et d’autres, l’un des prophètes. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent : « Pour les uns, Jean le Baptiste ; pour d’autres, Élie ; pour d’autres encore, l’un des prophètes. »
fr.R: Ils ont répondu : « Certains disent que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es Jean le Baptiste. D’autres disent que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es Élie. Et d’autres disent que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es l’un des prophètes. »

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, wakisema, "Yohana Mbatizaji; na wengine, Eliya; lakini wengine, mmoja wa manabii."
sw.B: Wakajibu, "Wengine wanasema Yohana Mbatizaji; wengine, Eliya; na wengine, mmoja wa manabii."
sw.R: Wakajibu, "Watu wengine wanasema {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Yohana Mbatizaji. Wengine wanasema {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Eliya. Na wengine wanasema {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mmoja wa manabii."

decisions.choice: the same opinions Herod heard in 6:14-15
decisions.reason: The answers repeat the views of 6:14-15 almost word for word.

decisions.choice: Elijah: the prophet promised to return before the day of the Lord
decisions.reason: Malachi 4:5. See 6:15.

decisions.choice: some people say you are
decisions.reason: Readable writes each answer as a full sentence.

decisions.choice: "Giăng Báp-tít" for "John the Baptist"
decisions.reason: The title in the Protestant tradition the style guide follows, kept as a fixed name; "Gio-an Tẩy Giả" is the Catholic form.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable supplies "you" (as the English Readable does); the disciples call Jesus "Thầy", the style guide's address for them, which here takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "세례자 요한" for John the Baptist; "예언자" for prophet
decisions.reason: "세례자 요한" says plainly that John is the one who baptizes; "세례 요한" is the older form. "예언자" follows the style guide (Settled), with "선지자" as the older word.

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς· Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι;

records.literal_gloss: And he was asking them, You but whom me do you say to be?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "But you, who do you say that I am?"
en.B: "And you," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "who do you say I am?"
en.R: Then Jesus asked them, "But what about you? Who do you say I am?"

vi.L: Và chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Còn các con, các con nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"
vi.B: Ngài hỏi họ: "Còn các con, các con nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Còn các con thì sao? Các con nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là ai?"

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 물으셨다. "그러면 너희는 나를 누구라고 말하느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "그러면 너희는 나를 누구라고 하느냐?"
ko.R: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "그러면 너희는 어떠냐? 너희는 나를 누구라고 하느냐?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les preguntaba: «Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿quién {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} que soy yo?».
es.B: «Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}», les preguntó, «¿quién {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} que soy yo?».
es.R: Entonces Jesús les preguntó: «Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, ¿qué {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}? ¿Quién soy yo?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} les interrogeait : « Mais vous, qui dites-vous que je suis ? »
fr.B: « Et vous, leur demanda-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}, qui dites-vous que je suis ? »
fr.R: Alors Jésus leur a demandé : « Et vous ? Qui dites-vous que je suis ? »

sw.L: Naye akawauliza, "Lakini ninyi, mnasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"
sw.B: "Na ninyi je," akawauliza, "mnasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, "Na ninyi je? Mnasema {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni nani?"

decisions.choice: you: emphatic, set against people
decisions.reason: The pronoun stands first: but you, unlike them.

decisions.choice: he: emphatic, he himself
decisions.reason: Mark adds the pronoun as Jesus turns the question on the disciples.

decisions.choice: "Et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} les interrogeait" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek puts an emphatic "he himself" (meaning decision); French shows that emphasis with the stressed pronoun "lui" as subject.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει αὐτῷ· Σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός.

records.literal_gloss: Answering Peter says to him, You are the Christ.

en.L: Peter answers and says to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "You are the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}."
en.B: Peter answered, "You are {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}."
en.R: Peter answered, "You are {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the King God promised to send!"

vi.L: Phi-e-rơ trả lời và thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}."
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ thưa: "Thầy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}."
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ trả lời: "Thầy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Vua mà Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa sai đến!"

ko.L: 베드로가 대답하여 그분께 말한다. "선생님은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다."
ko.B: 베드로가 대답하였다. "선생님은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다."
ko.R: 베드로가 대답했다. "선생님은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다. 하나님께서 보내시겠다고 약속하신 왕이십니다!"

es.L: Respondiendo Pedro, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dice: «Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}».
es.B: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondió: «Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}».
es.R: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contestó: «Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, el Rey que Dios prometió enviar».

fr.L: Pierre, répondant, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Tu es le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. »
fr.B: Pierre répondit : « Tu es le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. »
fr.R: Pierre a répondu : « Tu es le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, le roi que Dieu a promis d’envoyer ! »

sw.L: Petro akijibu anamwambia, "Wewe ndiwe {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}."
sw.B: Petro akajibu, "Wewe ndiwe {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}."
sw.R: Petro akajibu, "Wewe ndiwe {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mfalme ambaye Mungu aliahidi kumtuma!"

decisions.choice: the Christ: the Anointed One, the king God promised to send
decisions.reason: The word means anointed. Kings of Israel were anointed with oil, and the prophets promised a king from David's line who would set God's people free (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Isaiah 11:1-5). Mark used the title at 1:1.

decisions.choice: Peter's confession: the first time a disciple names Jesus as the Christ
decisions.reason: This is the turning point of Mark's Gospel. Peter sees who Jesus is, but the next verses show he does not yet see what kind of Christ he is (8:31-33).

decisions.choice: the King God promised to send
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title briefly.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" in Peter's confession
decisions.reason: The disciples call Jesus "Thầy" (Teacher), the style guide's form; Peter names who he is with the title itself. "Chúa" would read the later faith of the church into the address.

decisions.choice: "선생님은" for "you" in Peter's confession, in 합쇼체 with the honorific "이십니다"
decisions.reason: Korean does not say "당신" to a respected teacher; the disciples address Jesus as "선생님", as the crowd does in 3:32. "주님" would add a title the Greek does not have here.

decisions.choice: Tú eres el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: As in John 11:27: the article stays at every level, since Christ is a title here (meaning decision m1). "Tú" opens the quoted sentence, so it is written plain.

decisions.choice: "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}" at every level
decisions.reason: As French John (11:27) does: the Greek has the article, and "Tu es Christ" would read the title as a name, so the article stays outside the span and both options read naturally. A sentence-initial "Tu" addressed to Jesus is written plainly, as the French guide says.

decisions.choice: Wewe ndiwe Kristo, or Masihi with the setting (you are the one who is the Christ)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no article. "Ndiwe" (you are the one) marks the title as the Christ, so no reader takes "Kristo" as a mere name here, which is what the English "the Christ" does.

source.text: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ λέγωσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And he warned them that no one they should tell about him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} warned them that they should tell no one about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: He gave them strict orders not to tell anyone about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then Jesus strictly told them not to tell anyone who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiêm khắc răn họ đừng nói với ai về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài nghiêm cấm họ không được nói với ai về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nghiêm dặn họ không được nói cho ai biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 자기에 대하여 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 엄히 경고하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 자기에 관해서 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 단단히 이르셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 예수께서는 자기가 누구인지 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 제자들에게 엄하게 말씀하셨다.

es.L: Y les advirtió severamente que no hablaran a nadie acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Y les ordenó con firmeza que no le dijeran a nadie nada acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Entonces Jesús les ordenó con firmeza que no le dijeran a nadie quién era {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna sévèrement de ne parler de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à personne.
fr.B: Il leur défendit formellement de parler de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à qui que ce soit.
fr.R: Alors Jésus leur a donné un ordre sévère : ils ne devaient dire à personne qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était.

sw.L: Naye akawaonya kwamba wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Akawaagiza kwa ukali wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaagiza kwa nguvu wasimwambie mtu yeyote {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni nani.

decisions.choice: warned: gave a stern command
decisions.reason: This is the same verb used for Peter rebuking Jesus and Jesus rebuking Peter (8:32-33), and for Jesus silencing demons (1:25; 3:12). Here it is a strict order.

decisions.choice: tell no one: the title must not be spread until its meaning is clear
decisions.reason: Jesus does not deny the title. People would hear it as a call to war against Rome. He begins at once to teach what kind of Christ he is (8:31).

source.text: Καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς ὅτι δεῖ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ὑπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστῆναι·

records.literal_gloss: And he began to teach them that it is necessary the Son of Man many things to suffer and to be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes and to be killed and after three days to rise;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes and be killed and after three days rise again;
en.B: He then began teaching them that the Son of Man had to undergo great suffering, be rejected by elders, chief priests and scribes, be put to death, and rise again after three days.
en.R: Then Jesus began to teach {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers. He said that the Son of Man must go through many terrible sufferings. The leaders of the people, the leading priests and the teachers of God's law would reject {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He would be killed, but after three days {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would come back to life.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu dạy họ rằng Con Người phải chịu nhiều đau khổ, và bị các trưởng lão và các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo loại bỏ, và bị giết, và sau ba ngày sống lại;
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu dạy họ rằng Con Người phải chịu nhiều đau khổ, bị các trưởng lão, các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo loại bỏ, bị giết, và sau ba ngày sẽ sống lại.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu dạy các môn đồ. Ngài nói rằng Con Người phải chịu nhiều đau khổ khủng khiếp. Các nhà lãnh đạo của dân, các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy dạy luật sẽ loại bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sẽ bị giết, nhưng sau ba ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ sống lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 가르치기 시작하셨다. 인자가 많은 고난을 받고, 장로들과 대제사장들과 율법학자들에게 버림을 받고, 죽임을 당하고, 사흘 후에 다시 살아나야 한다는 것이었다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 제자들에게, 인자가 반드시 많은 고난을 받고 장로들과 대제사장들과 율법학자들에게 버림받아 죽임을 당하고, 사흘 뒤에 다시 살아나야 한다고 가르치기 시작하셨다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 예수께서 제자들을 가르치기 시작하셨다. 인자, 곧 사람의 아들은 앞으로 끔찍한 고난을 많이 겪어야 한다는 것이었다. 백성의 지도자들과 대제사장들과 율법을 가르치는 선생들이 인자를 버릴 것이다. 인자는 죽임을 당하겠지만, 사흘 뒤에 다시 살아날 것이다.

es.L: Y comenzó a enseñarles que es necesario que el Hijo del Hombre padezca mucho y sea rechazado por los ancianos y los principales sacerdotes y los escribas, y que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} maten, y que después de tres días resucite;
es.B: Entonces comenzó a enseñarles que el Hijo del Hombre tenía que sufrir mucho, ser rechazado por los ancianos, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los escribas, ser ejecutado y resucitar después de tres días.
es.R: Entonces Jesús comenzó a enseñar a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos. Les dijo que el Hijo del Hombre tenía que pasar por muchos sufrimientos terribles. Los líderes del pueblo, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los maestros de la ley de Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} iban a rechazar. Lo matarían, pero después de tres días volvería a la vida.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commença à leur enseigner qu’il faut que le Fils de l’homme souffre beaucoup, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit rejeté par les anciens et les chefs des prêtres et les scribes, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit tué, et qu’après trois jours {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ressuscite ;
fr.B: Il commença alors à leur enseigner que le Fils de l’homme devait beaucoup souffrir, être rejeté par les anciens, les chefs des prêtres et les scribes, être mis à mort, et ressusciter trois jours après.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus a commencé à enseigner {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples. Il leur a dit que le Fils de l’homme devait passer par de terribles souffrances. Les responsables du peuple, les chefs des prêtres et les spécialistes de la Loi allaient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} rejeter. On allait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tuer, mais trois jours après, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendrait à la vie.

sw.L: Naye akaanza kuwafundisha kwamba ni lazima Mwana wa Adamu apate mateso mengi, na kukataliwa na wazee na wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi, na kuuawa, na baada ya siku tatu kufufuka;
sw.B: Kisha akaanza kuwafundisha kwamba ilimpasa Mwana wa Adamu kupitia mateso makubwa, kukataliwa na wazee, wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi, kuuawa, na kufufuka baada ya siku tatu.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akaanza kuwafundisha wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Akasema kwamba ni lazima Mwana wa Adamu apitie mateso mengi ya kutisha. Viongozi wa watu, wakuu wa makuhani na walimu wa Sheria watamkataa. Atauawa, lakini baada ya siku tatu atafufuka.

decisions.choice: must: it is God's purpose, found in the Scriptures
decisions.reason: The word means it is necessary. In Mark the need comes from God's plan, written beforehand (9:12; 14:21, 14:49).

decisions.choice: rejected: the word of Psalm 118:22
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of the stone the builders rejected in Psalm 118:22, which Jesus quotes in 12:10.

decisions.choice: elders, chief priests, scribes: the three groups of the Jewish council in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Together they made up the Sanhedrin, the ruling council (14:53, 15:1). The chief priests were the high priest and leading priestly families.

decisions.choice: after three days: by the third day, counting in the Jewish way
decisions.reason: In Jewish counting part of a day counted as a day. Mark tells of the resurrection on the third day (16:1-2; compare 14:58, 15:29).

decisions.choice: the Son of Man: Jesus speaks of himself
decisions.reason: As in 2:10 and 2:28, Jesus uses the title for himself. It recalls the one like a son of man in Daniel 7:13-14.

decisions.choice: the leaders of the people
decisions.reason: Readable explains elders as leaders of the people, and uses teachers of God's law for scribes as in earlier chapters.

decisions.choice: "loại bỏ" for "rejected"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears Psalm 118:22, the stone the builders rejected; "loại bỏ" is the plain word for throwing out what is judged useless, which fits that picture.

decisions.choice: "các trưởng lão" (L, B); "các nhà lãnh đạo của dân" (R)
decisions.reason: "Trưởng lão" is the usual Vietnamese Bible word for the elders; here they are members of the council in Jerusalem (meaning decision), which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "인자" at every level; Readable adds "곧 사람의 아들" once in the chapter
decisions.reason: "인자" is the title in the Korean John (style guide, section 6); Readable explains it once, here, where it first appears in chapter 8. Jesus speaks of the Son of Man without honorifics, as he speaks of himself.

decisions.choice: "장로들" (L, B), "백성의 지도자들" (R); "대제사장들"; "율법학자들" (L, B), "율법을 가르치는 선생들" (R)
decisions.reason: The three groups of the council, in the words of the Korean John (대제사장들) and of Mark 3 (율법학자들); Readable says who the elders were.

decisions.choice: ancianos (L, B); líderes del pueblo (R); principales sacerdotes (L); jefes de los sacerdotes (B, R)
decisions.reason: The three groups of the council (meaning decision m3). The words for the priests are those of John 19:21; scribes as in 7:1.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre
decisions.reason: The title as in John 1:51, with capitals, and no gender setting.

decisions.choice: "les chefs des prêtres" (every level); "les anciens" (L, B), "les responsables du peuple" (R)
decisions.reason: As French John (11:47): "les grands prêtres" would suggest several high priests at once; "les chefs des prêtres" names the high priest and the leading priestly families. For the elders, Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu
decisions.reason: As in John 1:51: the settled Swahili title ("Adamu" is also humankind), never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: watamkataa, atauawa, atafufuka (future) at Readable
decisions.reason: Readable gives Jesus' teaching as his own words about what is coming; Swahili reported speech keeps the future tense, where English shifts to "would".

source.text: καὶ παρρησίᾳ τὸν λόγον ἐλάλει.

records.literal_gloss: And openly the word he was speaking.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was speaking the word openly.
en.B: He spoke about this quite plainly.
en.R: Jesus told them all this very plainly.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói lời ấy cách công khai.
vi.B: Ngài nói rõ điều này một cách thẳng thắn.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói rõ hết những điều này với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그 말씀을 드러내 놓고 하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 이 일을 아주 분명하게 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 이 모든 것을 숨김없이 분명하게 말씀해 주셨다.

es.L: Y hablaba la palabra abiertamente.
es.B: Y les hablaba de esto con toda claridad.
es.R: Jesús les dijo todo esto muy claramente.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait cette parole ouvertement.
fr.B: Il en parlait tout à fait clairement.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit tout cela très clairement.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akilisema neno hilo waziwazi.
sw.B: Aliyasema mambo hayo waziwazi kabisa.
sw.R: Yesu aliwaeleza mambo haya yote waziwazi.

decisions.choice: openly: plainly, without hiding the meaning
decisions.reason: Until now Jesus has taught in parables and kept his identity hidden. Now he tells the disciples plainly.

decisions.choice: the word: this message about his suffering
decisions.reason: The phrase points back to what he has just taught in 8:31.

decisions.choice: abiertamente (L); con toda claridad (B); muy claramente (R)
decisions.reason: As in John 11:14: plainly, without hiding the meaning (meaning decision m1).

source.text: καὶ προσλαβόμενος ὁ Πέτρος αὐτὸν ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken aside Peter him began to rebuke him.

en.L: And Peter took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} aside and began to rebuke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Peter took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to one side and began to rebuke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then Peter took Jesus away from the others and began to tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was wrong.

vi.L: Và Phi-e-rơ kéo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} riêng ra và bắt đầu quở trách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ kéo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra một bên và bắt đầu quở trách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ kéo Đức Giê-xu ra khỏi những người khác và bắt đầu nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói sai.

ko.L: 그러자 베드로가 그분을 따로 모시고 가서 그분을 꾸짖기 시작하였다.
ko.B: 그러자 베드로가 예수를 따로 모시고 가서 항의하기 시작하였다.
ko.R: 그러자 베드로가 예수를 다른 제자들에게서 떨어진 곳으로 모시고 갔다. 그리고 그렇게 말씀하시면 안 된다고 말리기 시작했다.

es.L: Y tomándolo aparte Pedro, comenzó a reprenderlo.
es.B: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevó aparte y comenzó a reprenderlo.
es.R: Entonces Pedro llevó a Jesús aparte de los demás y comenzó a decirle que estaba equivocado.

fr.L: Et Pierre, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant pris à part, commença à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} réprimander.
fr.B: Pierre {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prit à part et se mit à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} réprimander.
fr.R: Alors Pierre a emmené Jésus à l’écart des autres et a commencé à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dire qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait tort.

sw.L: Na Petro akamchukua kando, akaanza kumkemea.
sw.B: Petro akamvuta kando, akaanza kumkemea.
sw.R: Kisha Petro akamchukua Yesu kando, mbali na wengine, akaanza kumwambia kwamba amekosea.

decisions.choice: rebuke: speak sharply to correct
decisions.reason: The same verb as in 8:30 and 8:33. Peter speaks to Jesus as Jesus speaks to demons.

decisions.choice: taken aside: drew him away from the others
decisions.reason: Peter speaks to Jesus privately.

decisions.choice: tell him that he was wrong
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for rebuke.

decisions.choice: "quở trách" for Peter rebuking Jesus, the same word as Jesus rebuking Peter in 8:33
decisions.reason: Mark uses one verb for both; keeping one Vietnamese word shows how the rebuke is turned back on Peter. Readable says what Peter did, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "꾸짖기" (L); "항의하기" (B); "그렇게 말씀하시면 안 된다고 말리기" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the same verb as Jesus' rebuke in 8:33, so the clash stays visible; in Korean a disciple "꾸짖는" his teacher is jarring, so Balanced and Readable say what Peter did in words that fit a disciple, while "모시고" keeps his respect.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἐπιστραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἐπετίμησεν Πέτρῳ καὶ λέγει· Ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

records.literal_gloss: And having turned and having seen the disciples of him he rebuked Peter and says, Go behind me, Satan, because not you set your mind on the things of God but the things of the men.

en.L: But turning around and seeing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked Peter and says, "Get behind {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, Satan, because you are not setting your mind on the things of God but on the things of {{gender:people|men}}."
en.B: But Jesus turned and looked at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked Peter. "Get behind {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, Satan!" {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said. "Your mind is not on what God cares about, but on what people care about."
en.R: But Jesus turned around and looked at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked Peter. "Get behind {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, Satan!" {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said. "You are thinking the way people think, not the way God thinks."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay lại và nhìn các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, quở trách Phi-e-rơ và nói: "Hãy lui ra sau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, Sa-tan, vì ngươi không nghĩ đến những việc của Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng đến những việc của loài người."
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu quay lại, nhìn các môn đồ, rồi quở trách Phi-e-rơ: "Sa-tan, hãy lui ra sau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Ngươi không nghĩ đến những điều Đức Chúa Trời quan tâm, mà chỉ nghĩ đến những điều loài người quan tâm."
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu quay lại nhìn các môn đồ. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách Phi-e-rơ: "Sa-tan, hãy lui ra sau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Ngươi đang suy nghĩ theo cách của loài người, chứ không theo cách của Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 그러나 그분은 돌아서서 자기 제자들을 보시고 베드로를 꾸짖으시며 말씀하신다. "내 뒤로 가라, 사탄아. 너는 하나님의 것들이 아니라 사람들의 것들에 마음을 두고 있기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러자 예수께서 돌아서서 제자들을 보시고 베드로를 꾸짖으셨다. "사탄아, 내 뒤로 물러서라! 너는 하나님께서 마음에 두시는 일이 아니라 사람들이 마음에 두는 일을 생각하고 있다."
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서는 돌아서서 제자들을 바라보셨다. 그리고 베드로를 꾸짖으셨다. "사탄아, 내 뒤로 물러가거라! 너는 하나님처럼 생각하지 않고 사람들처럼 생각하는구나."

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, volviéndose y mirando a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, reprendió a Pedro y dice: «Ponte detrás de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, Satanás, porque no piensas en las cosas de Dios, sino en las de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}».
es.B: Pero Jesús se volvió, miró a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos y reprendió a Pedro. «¡Ponte detrás de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, Satanás!», le dijo. «Tú no piensas en lo que le importa a Dios, sino en lo que le importa a la gente».
es.R: Pero Jesús se volvió y miró a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos. Entonces reprendió a Pedro. «¡Ponte detrás de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, Satanás!», le dijo. «Tú piensas como piensa la gente, no como piensa Dios».

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, s’étant retourné et ayant vu {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, réprimanda Pierre et dit : « Va derrière {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, Satan, car tu ne penses pas aux choses de Dieu, mais à celles {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}. »
fr.B: Mais Jésus se retourna, regarda {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples et réprimanda Pierre : « Passe derrière {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, Satan ! lui dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}. Tu ne te soucies pas de ce qui compte pour Dieu, mais de ce qui compte pour les humains. »
fr.R: Mais Jésus s’est retourné et a regardé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a réprimandé Pierre. « Passe derrière {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, Satan ! lui a-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit. Tu penses comme pensent les gens, et non comme Dieu pense. »

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, akigeuka na kuwaona wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akamkemea Petro, naye anasema, "Rudi nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, Shetani, kwa sababu huyafikiri mambo ya Mungu bali mambo ya wanadamu."
sw.B: Lakini Yesu akageuka, akawatazama wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akamkemea Petro. "Rudi nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, Shetani!" akasema. "Mawazo yako hayako kwenye mambo anayojali Mungu, bali kwenye mambo wanayojali wanadamu."
sw.R: Lakini Yesu akageuka, akawatazama wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kisha akamkemea Petro. "Rudi nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, Shetani!" akasema. "Unafikiri kama wanadamu wanavyofikiri, si kama Mungu anavyofikiri."

decisions.choice: get behind me, Satan: Peter is speaking for Satan and must take his place behind Jesus as a follower
alternatives: get out of my sight forever
decisions.reason: Satan tested Jesus in 1:13, and Peter's words test him to turn from suffering. Behind me is the word used in 1:17 and 8:34 for following. Jesus sends Peter back to the place of a disciple.

decisions.choice: seeing his disciples: the rebuke is for all of them
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Peter with the others watching, since they shared his thinking.

decisions.choice: set your mind on: to think and care about
decisions.reason: The verb covers both thinking and what one aims at.

decisions.choice: what God cares about ... what people care about
alternatives: the things of God ... the things of men
decisions.reason: "The things of" is vague in English. Balanced says what the things are, and "people" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: thinking the way people think, not the way God thinks
alternatives: setting your mind on the things of God
decisions.reason: Readable turns the contrast into plain words and reverses the order for clarity.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" for "you" in the rebuke
decisions.reason: Jesus addresses Peter as Satan, so the warm "con" he uses for his disciples would clash with the words; "ngươi" is the form used to speak down to an adversary. It is old-fashioned, and a reviewer may prefer "con" to keep Peter in view.

decisions.choice: "내 뒤로 가라" (L); "내 뒤로 물러서라" (B); "내 뒤로 물러가거라" (R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "behind me", the place of a follower, which the meaning decision and its footnote point to; Literal keeps the bare verb "go".

decisions.choice: Ponte detrás de mí
decisions.reason: Peter is to take his place behind Jesus, as a follower does (meaning decision m1). The familiar "Quítate de delante de mí" would turn the picture around, so every level says "ponte detrás".

decisions.choice: "Va derrière moi" (L); "Passe derrière moi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as sending Peter back to his place behind Jesus, as a follower; "Arrière" or "Va-t’en" would only drive him away. Every level keeps "derrière moi", which 8:34 takes up ("venir derrière moi").

decisions.choice: Rudi nyuma yangu (get back behind me)
alternatives: Ondoka mbele yangu (get out of my sight)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Peter must take his place behind Jesus as a follower. "Rudi nyuma yangu" keeps "behind me", the place of a disciple (8:34 "kuja nyuma yangu"); "ondoka mbele yangu" would only send him away.

source.text: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

records.literal_gloss: And having called to [him] the crowd with the disciples of him he said to them, If anyone wants after me to come, let him deny himself and let him take up the cross of him and let him follow me.

en.L: And calling the crowd to [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "If anyone wants to come after {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, let {{gender:them|him}} deny {{gender:themselves|himself}} and take up {{gender:their|his}} cross and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called the crowd over, together with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, and said to them, "If anyone desires to come after {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, they must say no to themselves, take up their cross, and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Then Jesus called the crowd and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers to come near. He said to them, "If anyone wants to come with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, they must stop living for themselves. They must be ready to carry their own cross and die, and they must follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

vi.L: Và gọi đoàn dân cùng các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}], {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Nếu ai muốn theo sau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, người ấy hãy từ bỏ chính mình, vác thập tự giá mình và theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi đoàn dân cùng các môn đồ đến và nói với họ: "Ai muốn đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, người ấy phải từ bỏ chính mình, vác thập tự giá của mình và theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu gọi đoàn dân và các môn đồ đến gần. Ngài nói với họ: "Ai muốn đi với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thì phải thôi sống cho chính mình. Người ấy phải sẵn sàng vác thập tự giá của mình và chịu chết, và phải đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 무리를 자기 제자들과 함께 [가까이] 불러 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "누구든지 내 뒤를 따라오기를 원한다면, 그 사람은 자기 자신을 부인하고, 자기 십자가를 짊어지고, 나를 따라야 한다.
ko.B: 예수께서 무리를 제자들과 함께 가까이 부르시고 말씀하셨다. "누구든지 나를 따라오려는 사람은 자기 자신을 버리고, 자기 십자가를 지고 나를 따라야 한다.
ko.R: 예수께서 사람들과 제자들을 가까이 부르셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "누구든지 나와 함께 가고 싶은 사람은 자기만을 위해 사는 것을 그만두어야 한다. 자기 십자가를 지고 죽을 각오를 해야 한다. 그리고 나를 따라와야 한다.

es.L: Y llamando a la multitud junto con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, les dijo: «Si alguno quiere venir en pos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, niéguese a sí mismo, y tome su cruz, y sígame.
es.B: Luego llamó a la multitud, junto con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, y les dijo: «Si alguien quiere venir detrás de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, que renuncie a sí mismo, tome su cruz y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} siga.
es.R: Entonces Jesús llamó a la gente y a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos para que se acercaran. Les dijo: «Si alguien quiere venir conmigo, tiene que dejar de vivir para sí mismo. Tiene que estar dispuesto a cargar su propia cruz y morir, y tiene que seguirme.

fr.L: Et, ayant appelé la foule avec {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Si quelqu’un veut venir derrière {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, qu’il se renie lui-même, et qu’il prenne sa croix, et qu’il {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suive.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} appela la foule ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, et leur dit : « Si quelqu’un veut venir derrière {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, qu’il renonce à lui-même, qu’il se charge de sa croix et qu’il {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suive.
fr.R: Alors Jésus a appelé la foule et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples à venir près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il leur a dit : « Si quelqu’un veut venir avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, il doit arrêter de vivre pour lui-même. Il doit être prêt à porter sa croix et à mourir, et il doit {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivre.

sw.L: Na akiuita umati pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akawaambia, "Mtu yeyote akitaka kuja nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake, anifuate.
sw.B: Kisha akauita umati pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akawaambia, "Mtu yeyote anayetaka kuja nyuma {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ni lazima ajikatae mwenyewe, abebe msalaba wake, na anifuate.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akauita umati na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waje karibu. Akawaambia, "Mtu yeyote anayetaka kuja pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ni lazima aache kuishi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe. Ni lazima awe tayari kubeba msalaba wake na kufa, na anifuate.

decisions.choice: deny himself: say no to oneself, give up the claim to run one's own life
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of Peter denying Jesus (14:30, 14:72). To deny oneself is to disown oneself in the same way, putting Jesus first.

decisions.choice: take up the cross: as a condemned man carried his cross to the place of death
decisions.reason: Rome made condemned men carry the crossbeam to their execution (15:21). The picture is of walking to one's death, ready to give one's life.

decisions.choice: anyone ... let him: a saying for every person
decisions.reason: The pronouns are masculine as Greek grammar requires, but the saying is for anyone in the crowd.

decisions.choice: the crowd with his disciples: the call to follow is for everyone
decisions.reason: Jesus calls the crowd in as well. The way of the cross is not only for leaders.

decisions.choice: they ... themselves ... their
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use they, themselves and their with anyone, a natural inclusive form in English, since the saying is for everyone. Literal gives the traditional form as a setting.

decisions.choice: be ready to carry their own cross and die
decisions.reason: Readable says what carrying a cross meant.

decisions.choice: "thập tự giá"
decisions.reason: The Protestant word, as in the Vietnamese Colossians (2:14); "thập giá" is the Catholic one.

decisions.choice: "자기 자신을 부인하고" (L); "자기 자신을 버리고" (B); "자기만을 위해 사는 것을 그만두어야" (R)
decisions.reason: "부인하다" keeps the Greek word but in everyday Korean means "deny a fact"; Balanced says giving up the claim to oneself, and Readable says what that means for how one lives.

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Si alguien ... que renuncie a sí mismo" needs no pronoun for the person apart from the reflexive, which Spanish uses for anyone, so no setting applies (as in John 11:9). "Sígame" and "seguirme" join the pronoun to the verb and stay plain.

decisions.choice: en pos de mí (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the old but still understood phrase for coming after someone as a follower; Balanced says "detrás de mí", Readable "conmigo".

decisions.choice: "quelqu’un ... qu’il ... lui-même ... sa croix" with no gender setting, here and in 8:35-38
decisions.reason: English needs {{gender:them|him}} for the pronouns. French "quelqu’un", "celui qui" and "qui" already mean anyone, and "il", "lui", "lui-même" taking them up are ordinary generic French; "sa croix", "sa vie" agree with the noun, not the person. So, as the French guide says, no span. The setting stays on the noun for a human being (8:36-37).

decisions.choice: mtu yeyote ... mwenyewe ... wake, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "mtu yeyote" (anyone) and "-ake", "mwenyewe" have no gender, so the saying already speaks to every person and the English gender spans have nothing to change.

decisions.choice: ajikane (L); ajikatae (B); aache kuishi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe (R)
decisions.reason: "Kujikana" is the established word for denying oneself; Balanced says "ajikatae" (say no to oneself), the plainer form of the meaning decision, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι ἀπολέσει αὐτήν· ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσει τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου σώσει αὐτήν.

records.literal_gloss: Whoever for if wants the life of him to save will lose it; whoever but will lose the life of him on account of me and the gospel will save it.

en.L: For whoever wants to save {{gender:their|his}} life will lose it, but whoever loses {{gender:their|his}} life on account of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and the gospel will save it.
en.B: Anyone set on keeping their life safe will lose it, and anyone who loses their life because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and the gospel will save it.
en.R: Some people try hard to keep their life safe for themselves, but they will lose it. Others give up their life because of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and the good news. They will save it.

vi.L: Vì ai muốn cứu mạng sống mình thì sẽ mất nó; còn ai mất mạng sống mình vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vì Tin Lành thì sẽ cứu được nó.
vi.B: Ai muốn giữ an toàn mạng sống mình thì sẽ mất nó; còn ai mất mạng sống mình vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vì Tin Lành thì sẽ cứu được nó.
vi.R: Có người cố hết sức giữ mạng sống mình cho riêng mình, nhưng họ sẽ mất nó. Có người chịu mất mạng sống mình vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vì Tin Lành. Họ sẽ cứu được nó.

ko.L: 누구든지 자기 목숨을 구하려고 하는 사람은 그것을 잃을 것이고, 누구든지 나와 복음 때문에 자기 목숨을 잃는 사람은 그것을 구할 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 자기 목숨을 지키려는 사람은 그것을 잃을 것이고, 나와 복음 때문에 자기 목숨을 잃는 사람은 그것을 구할 것이다.
ko.R: 자기 목숨을 지키려고 애쓰는 사람들이 있다. 그러나 그들은 목숨을 잃을 것이다. 나와 기쁜 소식 때문에 목숨을 잃는 사람들도 있다. 그들은 목숨을 구할 것이다.

es.L: Porque el que quiera salvar su vida, la perderá; pero el que pierda su vida por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y del evangelio, la salvará.
es.B: El que se empeñe en poner a salvo su vida, la perderá; y el que pierda su vida por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y del evangelio, la salvará.
es.R: Algunas personas se esfuerzan por guardar su vida para sí mismas, pero la perderán. Otras dan su vida por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y de la buena noticia. Esas la salvarán.

fr.L: Car celui qui veut sauver sa vie la perdra ; mais celui qui perdra sa vie à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de l’Évangile la sauvera.
fr.B: Qui cherche à garder sa vie sauve la perdra ; et qui perd sa vie à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de l’Évangile la sauvera.
fr.R: Certains essaient de toutes leurs forces de garder leur vie pour eux-mêmes, mais ils la perdront. D’autres donnent leur vie à cause de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de la bonne nouvelle. Ceux-là la sauveront.

sw.L: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuuokoa uhai wake ataupoteza; lakini yeyote atakayeupoteza uhai wake kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kwa ajili ya Injili atauokoa.
sw.B: Mtu anayeshikilia kuulinda uhai wake ataupoteza, na mtu anayeupoteza uhai wake kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kwa ajili ya Injili atauokoa.
sw.R: Watu wengine hujitahidi sana kuulinda uhai wao kwa ajili yao wenyewe, lakini wataupoteza. Wengine hutoa uhai wao kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kwa ajili ya Habari Njema. Hao watauokoa.

decisions.choice: life: the self, the life a person lives now and the life beyond death
alternatives: only the soul as distinct from the body
decisions.reason: The word means a person's life or self. In 8:35-37 it moves between this life, which may be lost, and the true life that God keeps. The same word is often rendered soul in 8:36-37; keeping one word lets the saying be heard as one.

decisions.choice: save, lose: a paradox about following Jesus
decisions.reason: Those who hold on to their life to keep it safe lose it in the end. Those who give it up for Jesus gain it in the end.

decisions.choice: on account of me and the gospel, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: A few early manuscripts lack "me and". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: their (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 8:34, Balanced and Readable use their for a saying meant for anyone.

decisions.choice: two pairs of short sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks each half of the saying into its own sentences.

decisions.choice: "mạng sống" for "life" (psyche), also 8:36-37
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese John (12:25): "sự sống" is kept for zoe, and "linh hồn" (soul) would narrow a word that means the whole self, now and beyond death (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Tin Lành" for "the gospel" at every level
decisions.reason: "Tin Lành" means "good news" in plain Vietnamese, so Readable needs no other word, and it is the Protestant term the style guide follows; "Tin Mừng" is the Catholic word.

decisions.choice: "목숨" for psyche at every level, here and in 8:36-37
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John and Mark 3:4, "목숨" is the life a person has and can lose, and "생명" is kept for zoe; the same word through 8:35-37 keeps the paradox together. The meaning footnote explains the wider sense.

decisions.choice: "복음" (L, B); "기쁜 소식" (R)
decisions.reason: "복음" is the established church word; Readable uses its plain meaning, as the Korean of 3:14 does for the preaching of the Twelve.

decisions.choice: evangelio (L, B); buena noticia (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:1.

decisions.choice: "sa vie" at every level, here and in 8:36-37
decisions.reason: The word means the self and its life, now and beyond death (meaning decision, with its footnote). "Âme" would split the saying into body and soul and lose the paradox of losing and saving one’s life; "vie" keeps one word through 8:35-37, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "l’Évangile" (L, B); "la bonne nouvelle" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the other French books (Colossians, 1 Peter) and the English key term: the church word at Literal and Balanced, the plain words at Readable.

decisions.choice: uhai (life) at every level, also in 8:36-37
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as the self, the life lived now and the life beyond death. "Uhai" (being alive, life itself) keeps one word through 8:35-37, as Mark does, and fits both halves of the paradox; "nafsi" would stress the inner soul and lose the picture of losing one's life, while "maisha" is daily living. A reviewer may prefer "nafsi" in 8:36-37.

decisions.choice: Injili (L, B); Habari Njema (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 1:1, for the whole book.

source.text: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον κερδῆσαι τὸν κόσμον ὅλον καὶ ζημιωθῆναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: What for does it profit a man to gain the world whole and to forfeit the life of him?

en.L: For what does it profit {{gender:a person|a man}} to gain the whole world and forfeit {{gender:their|his}} life?
en.B: What does anyone gain by winning the whole world, if it costs them their life?
en.R: Suppose someone owned the whole world but lost their life. What good would that be to them?

vi.L: Vì một người được cả thế gian mà mất mạng sống mình thì có ích gì?
vi.B: Một người được cả thế gian mà phải mất mạng sống mình thì được lợi gì?
vi.R: Giả sử có người được làm chủ cả thế gian, nhưng lại mất mạng sống mình. Điều đó có ích gì cho người ấy?

ko.L: 사람이 온 세상을 얻고 자기 목숨을 잃는 것이 그에게 무슨 이익이 되겠느냐?
ko.B: 누가 온 세상을 차지한다 해도 자기 목숨을 잃는다면, 그것이 무슨 소용이 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 온 세상을 다 가졌다고 해 보자. 그런데 자기 목숨을 잃었다. 그러면 그것이 그 사람에게 무슨 도움이 되겠느냐?

es.L: Porque ¿de qué le sirve a {{gender:una persona|un hombre}} ganar el mundo entero y perder su vida?
es.B: ¿De qué le sirve a alguien ganar el mundo entero, si eso le cuesta la vida?
es.R: Supongamos que alguien fuera dueño del mundo entero, pero perdiera su vida. ¿De qué le serviría?

fr.L: Car à quoi sert-il à {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} de gagner le monde entier et de perdre sa vie ?
fr.B: Que gagne-t-on à conquérir le monde entier, si l’on y perd sa vie ?
fr.R: Supposons que quelqu’un possède le monde entier, mais qu’il perde sa vie. À quoi cela lui servirait-il ?

sw.L: Kwa maana inamfaidia nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote na kupata hasara ya uhai wake?
sw.B: Mtu anapata faida gani kwa kuushinda ulimwengu wote, ikiwa itamgharimu uhai wake?
sw.R: Tuseme mtu fulani anamiliki ulimwengu wote lakini anapoteza uhai wake. Hilo lingemfaidia nini?

decisions.choice: life: the same word as in 8:35, the self that may be lost forever
alternatives: soul as one part of a person
decisions.reason: The traditional rendering here is soul. The word is the one used for life in 8:35, and the loss meant is of the whole person before God.

decisions.choice: the world: everything people can own or win
decisions.reason: The point is the greatest possible gain.

decisions.choice: forfeit: lose as a penalty
decisions.reason: The verb is used of loss or damage paid as a penalty. It is the language of accounts: profit and loss.

decisions.choice: anyone (B); someone (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use inclusive words for a saying about any person.

source.text: τί γὰρ δοῖ ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: What for would give a man [as] exchange for the life of him?

en.L: For what would {{gender:a person|a man}} give in exchange for {{gender:their|his}} life?
en.B: What could anyone give to buy their life back?
en.R: What could a person give to get their life back? Nothing is worth that much!

vi.L: Vì người ta sẽ lấy gì để đổi lại mạng sống mình?
vi.B: Người ta có thể lấy gì để chuộc lại mạng sống mình?
vi.R: Một người có thể đưa ra cái gì để lấy lại mạng sống mình? Chẳng có gì quý bằng mạng sống ấy!

ko.L: 사람이 자기 목숨의 대가로 무엇을 내주겠느냐?
ko.B: 사람이 무엇을 주고 자기 목숨을 되찾을 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 사람이 무엇을 주어야 자기 목숨을 되찾을 수 있겠느냐? 그만한 값어치가 있는 것은 아무것도 없다!

es.L: Porque ¿qué podría dar {{gender:una persona|un hombre}} a cambio de su vida?
es.B: ¿Qué podría dar alguien para rescatar su vida?
es.R: ¿Qué podría dar una persona para recuperar su vida? ¡No hay nada que valga tanto!

fr.L: Car que donnerait {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} en échange de sa vie ?
fr.B: Que pourrait-on donner pour racheter sa vie ?
fr.R: Qu’est-ce qu’une personne pourrait donner pour retrouver sa vie ? Rien n’a autant de valeur !

sw.L: Kwa maana mtu atatoa nini badala ya uhai wake?
sw.B: Mtu angeweza kutoa nini ili kuukomboa uhai wake?
sw.R: Mtu angeweza kutoa nini ili kuupata tena uhai wake? Hakuna kitu chenye thamani kiasi hicho!

decisions.choice: exchange: a price paid in return
decisions.reason: The word means something given in exchange. Psalm 49:8-9 says no one can pay God the price of a life.

decisions.choice: life: the same word as in 8:35-36
decisions.reason: Once a life is lost there is nothing anyone could pay to get it back.

decisions.choice: Nothing is worth that much!
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer nothing. Readable states it.

source.text: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους ἐν τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ μοιχαλίδι καὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται αὐτὸν ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων τῶν ἁγίων.

records.literal_gloss: Whoever for if is ashamed of me and my words in the generation this the adulterous and sinful, also the Son of Man will be ashamed of him, when he comes in the glory of the Father of him with the angels the holy.

en.L: For whoever is ashamed of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of {{gender:them|him}} when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes in the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Father with the holy angels."
en.B: Whoever is ashamed of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and of what I say, here among this adulterous, sinful generation, the Son of Man will in turn be ashamed of them, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes with the holy angels in the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Father."
en.R: The people of today have turned away from God and are full of sin. Among them, some people will be ashamed of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and of what I teach. When the Son of Man comes with the holy angels in the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Father, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be ashamed of them."

vi.L: Vì ai hổ thẹn về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và về lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa thế hệ gian dâm và tội lỗi này, thì Con Người cũng sẽ hổ thẹn về người ấy khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến trong vinh quang của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với các thiên sứ thánh."
vi.B: Ai hổ thẹn về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và về lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa thế hệ gian dâm và tội lỗi này, thì Con Người cũng sẽ hổ thẹn về người ấy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến cùng các thiên sứ thánh trong vinh quang của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Người đời nay đã quay lưng với Đức Chúa Trời và đầy dẫy tội lỗi. Giữa họ, có người sẽ hổ thẹn vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vì lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dạy. Khi Con Người đến cùng các thiên sứ thánh trong vinh quang của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng sẽ hổ thẹn vì những người ấy."

ko.L: 누구든지 이 간음하는 죄 많은 세대 가운데서 나와 나의 말들을 부끄럽게 여기면, 인자도 자기 아버지의 영광 가운데 거룩한 천사들과 함께 올 때에 그 사람을 부끄럽게 여길 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 하나님께 신실하지 못하고 죄로 가득한 이 세대 가운데서 누구든지 나와 내 말을 부끄럽게 여기면, 인자도 거룩한 천사들과 함께 자기 아버지의 영광에 싸여 올 때에 그 사람을 부끄럽게 여길 것이다."
ko.R: 오늘날 사람들은 하나님을 떠났고, 죄로 가득하다. 그런 사람들 가운데서 나와 내 가르침을 부끄럽게 여기는 사람들이 있을 것이다. 인자가 거룩한 천사들과 함께 아버지의 영광에 싸여 올 때에, 인자도 그런 사람들을 부끄럽게 여길 것이다."

es.L: Porque el que se avergüence de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras en esta generación adúltera y pecadora, también el Hijo del Hombre se avergonzará de {{gender:esa persona|él}} cuando venga en la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Padre con los santos ángeles».
es.B: Si alguien se avergüenza de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y de lo que digo, aquí, en medio de esta generación adúltera y pecadora, también el Hijo del Hombre se avergonzará de {{gender:esa persona|él}} cuando venga con los santos ángeles en la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Padre».
es.R: La gente de hoy se ha apartado de Dios y está llena de pecado. Entre esa gente, algunos se avergonzarán de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y de lo que enseño. Cuando el Hijo del Hombre venga con los santos ángeles en la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Padre, se avergonzará de ellos».

fr.L: Car celui qui aura honte de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles dans cette génération adultère et pécheresse, le Fils de l’homme aussi aura honte de lui, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra dans la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Père avec les saints anges. »
fr.B: Si quelqu’un a honte de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles au milieu de cette génération adultère et pécheresse, de même le Fils de l’homme aura honte de lui quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra avec les saints anges dans la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Père. »
fr.R: Les gens d’aujourd’hui se sont détournés de Dieu et sont pleins de péché. Parmi eux, certains auront honte de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et de ce que j’enseigne. Quand le Fils de l’homme viendra avec les saints anges dans la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Père, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura honte d’eux. »

sw.L: Kwa maana yeyote atakayenionea aibu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika kizazi hiki cha uzinzi na dhambi, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu atakapokuja katika utukufu wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pamoja na malaika watakatifu."
sw.B: Mtu yeyote anayenionea aibu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, hapa kati ya kizazi hiki cha uzinzi na dhambi, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu, atakapokuja pamoja na malaika watakatifu katika utukufu wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.R: Watu wa siku hizi wamemwacha Mungu na wamejaa dhambi. Kati yao, watu wengine watanionea aibu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} na mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja pamoja na malaika watakatifu katika utukufu wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} naye atawaonea aibu watu hao."

decisions.choice: adulterous: unfaithful to God
decisions.reason: The prophets called Israel an adulterous wife when it turned to other gods (Hosea 2:2-5; Ezekiel 16:32). The word speaks of broken faith with God.

decisions.choice: ashamed of: refuse to own or stand by
decisions.reason: To be ashamed of Jesus is to disown him. The Son of Man will disown such a person in turn.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man comes in glory: the vision of Daniel 7:13-14
decisions.reason: One like a son of man comes with the clouds and receives glory and a kingdom. Jesus speaks of this again in 13:26 and 14:62.

decisions.choice: the glory of his Father: God's own glory, shown in the Son
decisions.reason: Jesus calls God his Father. The glory is God's own presence and splendor.

decisions.choice: the people of today have turned away from God and are full of sin
decisions.reason: Readable explains what adulterous means here and puts it in its own sentence.

decisions.choice: them
decisions.reason: As in 8:34, Balanced and Readable use them for a saying meant for anyone.

decisions.choice: "gian dâm" for "adulterous"
decisions.reason: The word keeps the prophets' picture of unfaithfulness to God as adultery (meaning decision); Readable states the sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for the Son of Man when Jesus speaks of him in the third person
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son of Man; the third-person pronoun is the narrator's "Ngài", with the deity_pronoun span, as the English has it.

decisions.choice: "간음하는" (L); "하나님께 신실하지 못한" (B); "하나님을 떠난" (R)
decisions.reason: The adultery is unfaithfulness to God, as the meaning decision says; Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable say what it means. "음란한" suggests sexual indecency rather than broken faith.

decisions.choice: {{gender:esa persona|él}}
decisions.reason: As in John 11:10: the stressed "él" here means anyone at all, so it takes the gender setting. Readable uses the plural, which needs none.

decisions.choice: kizazi hiki cha uzinzi (this adulterous generation)
alternatives: kizazi kisicho na uaminifu (an unfaithful generation)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "adulterous" as unfaithful to God. Literal and Balanced keep the prophets' picture of adultery, as the English does; Readable says what it means, "wamemwacha Mungu" (have left God).
